messages:
Maya S: Heads up — MidWestEdge dropped ~60% monthly token usage compared to last month. Renewal ~30 days out. Seeing chatter from their new ML lead about pricing and speed. Putting a triage thread here.
Leah (AE): Thanks Maya. I met their new Head of ML (Ravi) yesterday — he's running a competitive eval (GenAIHub) and flagged better latency numbers. They also did a product reorg and cut some production queries.
Priya C: Onboarding view: last model rollout failed on 2026-02-18; feature-store integration still pending. I've opened a task with infra to find the blocker.
Jorge R: Support notes: ticket #8762 shows repeated timeouts around 02/18, logs contain `timeout=500ms` spikes. Also ticket #8841 for degraded KV cache hits.
Sam K: We rolled back an autoscaler config yesterday that was causing request drops. That should have stopped the timeouts.
Maya S: Usage hasn't recovered despite the rollback — product team said they switched some flows to an in-house reranker to avoid latency. Renewal risk looks elevated.
Leah (AE): @Maya can you confirm executive sponsors and primary contacts so I can map stakeholders before outreach?
Maya S: Sponsors/contacts: Erin (CTO, new since Jan), Ravi (Head of ML), Kelsey (Product Director). Primary billing contact is still Finance lead Aaron.
Priya C: Recommendation: run a 2-week technical health-check + pilot showing caching + quantization impact on their prompt set. Offer a short discounted pilot on Dedicated to prove cost/latency tradeoffs.
Leah (AE): Draft playbook: 1) Exec check-in with Erin (business impact) 2) Technical deep-dive with Ravi + Sam 3) ROI demo using their prompts + eval results 4) Short discounted pilot if they push back. Need baseline metrics from support and usage.
Jorge R: Collating logs and will attach a 48h window around the incidents. Ticket refs: 8762, 8841. Will add query samples and error rates.
Maya S: Ravi said quote: "we need faster at the same quality" — sounds like latency is their top priority but accuracy can't drop.
Priya C: We can prepare an inference profile: enable KV prefix caching, small-batch low-latency mode, and a quantized variant. We'll run their eval-suite and surface any quality regressions + suggested fallbacks.
Leah (AE): I'll loop in Product for a short "cost vs latency" slide and Research for a quantization performance matrix. Proposed dates: exec call week of Feb 1, technical deep-dive Feb 2. Are those OK?
Sam K: Feb 2 works for me for the deep-dive. I can provision a small Dedicated pool for a 2-week pilot and capture perf metrics.
OnboardingBot: Account update: CSM reassigned -> Priya C on 2026-01-15.
Maya S: Let's define success metric: recover to at least +20% active prompts or convert the reranker flow back before renewal.
Leah (AE): Action items: Leah -> schedule exec call; Priya -> prepare health-check & eval harness; Sam -> provision pilot; Jorge -> attach logs + ticket summaries. I'll send invites and a short agenda.
SupportBot: Logged action: ticket 8762 assigned to eng-infra, SLA updated to P2.
Priya C: I'll set a 30m enablement session for Ravi + product on Feb 3 to walk through integration quick wins.
Maya S: Thanks all. Risk: high but salvageable if we move quickly and show measurable ROI. I'll draft an exec note for renewal ops and share before EOD. :thumbsup:
Leah (AE): Got it — will follow-up in calendar and with a short email template for Erin.
